defs.def: freedom to live as you choose without too many restrictions from government or authority 自由（自己选择生活方式而不受政府或权威限制）

ex.s: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth, upon this continent, a new nation, conceived in Liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.
ex.t: 四分七年前,我们的父亲在这个大陆上诞生了一个新的国家,这个国家是在自由中构想的,并致力于实现人人生而平等的主张.

ex.s: Liberty was the basis of their endeavours, as well as the idea that every individual is created equal.
ex.t: 自由是他们努力的基础，同时每个人生来平等的理念也是……

ex.s: There are many other symbols of America, such as the Statue of Liberty, Hollywood, and Broadway.
ex.t: 美国还有许多其他象征，如自由女神像、好莱坞和百老汇。

ex.s: Visitors can see these (amaze) creatures in their natural domain, and also sponsor an elephant to preserve its health and liberty.
ex.t: 游客可以在它们的自然栖息地看到这些（令人惊叹的）生物，也可以资助一头大象来保护它的健康和自由。

ex.s: Screenwriters 15 take creative liberty and sometimes there may be changes to the plot, additions, and even different endings to please producers, directors and test audiences.
ex.t: 编剧们发挥创作自由，有时可能会有情节变化、添加、甚至不同的结局来取悦制片人、导演和试映观众。

defs.def: the state of not being a prisoner or a slave 自由（不受关押或奴役的状态）
the legal right and freedom to do sth 自由（做某事的合法权利及行动自由）
an act or a statement that may offend or annoy sb, especially because it is done without permission or does not show respect 冒犯行为（或言语）；放肆；失礼
to make important and unreasonable changes to sth, especially a book （尤指对书）任意窜改
to be too friendly with sb, especially in a sexual way 过分亲昵；放肆；狎昵；调戏
